rag-pipeline.description: RAG ingestion task image: suspended CronJob in ewallet-cicd and one smoke Job against an ephemeral Redis (rubric row 33).

prompt-registry-gate.description: Read-only Prompt Management gate: every Git-pinned prompt version is byte-identical in agentregistry (rubric row 34). It does not prove runtime consumption.

mcp-servers.description: Both MCP servers (feature-rag-mcp, drift-mcp) from the released mcp-server image with their real authentication stack (rubric row 34).

agent-fleet.description: Feature-RAG and Drift Specialists run with the SandboxAgent actor contract of infra/kubernetes/agent-sandbox/fleet.yaml.tmpl (cmd, args, port 80, PATH/PYTHONPATH) from the released image (rubric row 34).

coordinator.description: Fraud Coordinator (BYO Agent) from the released image with its idempotency Redis and the Sandbox-only specialist routing configuration (rubric row 35).

streaming-block-a.description: Flink and sink images: image smoke in ewallet-cicd, then the real Block A topology (Redpanda, Flink, sink Jobs) for one verify-* campaign with dedicated GCS prefixes and the rehearsal-stream Online Store, with Offline/Online parity (rubric row 36).

agent-staging.description: Isolated Agent staging (V2-P3A, Architecture A'): Helm release llm-agent-staging (values-staging.yaml) in ewallet-agents-staging, the dedicated WorkerPool staging-agents and both Specialist SandboxAgents in ewallet-sandbox-staging, typed Specialist and Coordinator E2E (fraud, drift, combined) and security negatives, then removal of everything the run created (scripts/ci/agent_staging.py). Runs only from release/agent-staging with DEPLOY_APPROVED and the Jenkins approval step; never touches a production namespace.

mcp-servers-production.description: Image-only promotion of llm-agent-mcp through Helm (scripts/ci/release_state.py checks, helm upgrade --atomic).

agent-fleet-candidate.description: Release-scoped candidate SandboxAgents (feature-rag-specialist-cicd, drift-specialist-cicd) in ewallet-sandbox on the shared WorkerPool, rendered from the frozen fleet template, verified Ready with a gVisor golden actor and by typed direct A2A known-answer requests, then deleted (scripts/ci/sandbox_candidate.py). Additive and production-namespaced, so it runs only inside an approved production stage, before any promotion.

agent-fleet-production.description: Image-only promotion of the two production SandboxAgents (ewallet-sandbox) by a JSON patch of spec.byo.deployment.image with uid and image test operations; no Helm migration, ownership unchanged; rollback patches the recorded image back (scripts/ci/fleet_promote.py).

coordinator-production.description: Image-only promotion of the Coordinator in llm-agent through Helm, after the MCP servers and the SandboxAgent fleet of the same release SHA, then business E2E (fraud, drift, combined) through the Coordinator, A2A Gateway, SandboxAgents and MCP Gateway. Agent Registry readback is not a rollback gate: its image-digest labels go stale on any promotion until the separately approved publication (production_release registry follow-up).
